note: Pre-registered outcome space. No outcome is scored as supporting the programme by default. Assignment requires cited evidence from the mapping.

O1.label: independent recovery substantially equivalent
O1.evidence_required: EXPLICIT_RECOVERY or LOGICAL_CONSEQUENCE on EVERY project element, reverse direction complete, contamination C0 or C1, tier T4 or higher. Anything less is O2 at best.
O1.layer_1_descriptive: Classifiable at any tier and contamination level.
O1.layer_2_requires: Tier T4+, contamination C0/C1 with INDEPENDENCE_VALUE intact, qualified respondent, no procedural failure. O1 additionally requires EXPLICIT_RECOVERY or LOGICAL_CONSEQUENCE on every project element with the reverse direction complete.
O1.direction_neutrality: This outcome carries the same independence bar as every other. Its being favourable or unfavourable to the programme is irrelevant to the bar.

assignment_rules: Exactly one primary Layer-1 outcome. Secondary Layer-1 outcomes permitted where they also hold.
Layer-2 claims are stated separately from Layer-1 classification and never merged with it.
Every assignment cites specific structural relations and recovery classes.
Contamination degrades INDEPENDENCE_VALUE in both directions; descriptive value is retained at every level.
No single run establishes universality, at any tier.
An outcome may not be revised after origins are disclosed, except as a separately recorded correction with its reason.

two_layer_model.rationale: An earlier revision applied a tier and contamination bar to O1 alone, of twelve outcomes. Every other outcome, including those unfavourable to the programme, could be asserted at any tier and any contamination level. That is an asymmetric evidential standard. No direction gets a lower independence bar because it hurts or helps the programme.
two_layer_model.LAYER_1_descriptive_run_outcome: What this respondent actually produced. Classifiable at ANY tier and ANY contamination level. A descriptive outcome is a fact about the run.
two_layer_model.LAYER_2_warranted_claim: What may be inferred from that outcome, gated by evidence tier, contamination level and its INDEPENDENCE_VALUE, respondent qualification, protocol integrity, and replication count.
two_layer_model.worked_example: A T1 run may descriptively produce an alien formulation (Layer 1, O6). It may NOT support 'an independent investigator derived an alien formulation' (Layer 2), because T1 establishes no independence of any kind.
two_layer_model.uniform_bar: For ANY outcome to support a Layer-2 claim about independent elicitation, the run requires tier T4 or higher, contamination C0 or C1, a qualified respondent per the tier rules, and no recorded procedural failure. This applies identically to recovery outcomes and to divergence outcomes.
